seed: Objects of type `arm` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [block,block,block,block,player] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Crane/skewer game: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-/+6, carrying blocks on the beam and chain-pushing blocks hit; any blocked block cancels the whole move.
A4/A3 change beam w by +/-6 (1..43). A next/collected block hooked at the tip (x==end-5) makes every on-beam block follow the tip; otherwise extending chain-pushes newly hit blocks, and a blocked group leaves the blocks in place while the beam slides.
Hypothesis resolved: arm A4 no-op (t15) = beam already at max w 43 with the hooked block at max x 48; t14 extends because w was 37.
Tags: a hooked next block alone on the beam (plus collected) becomes collected and the rightmost todo becomes next; a collected block leaving the beam reverts to next. Clicks/A5/A7 are no-ops. Stateless.
Unconfirmed: exact bounds (block y>=2, x<=48) and how several collected blocks would revert.
